Nina: Heads-up — CatalystRx QBR Fri. Finance asked for a single spend slide + onboarding blockers.
Carlos: On it. I'll pull 45/60d token history and a 2-week scenario set.
Eileen: Quick snapshot: billing period tokens = 76.4M, avg daily = 2.8M, webhook pilot introduced bursts (~+50% last 7d).
Samir: Risk note: sustained burst -> they'll hit 100% retainer in ~11 days. Recommend short-term top-up + commit discussion.
FinOps-Bot: alert: CatalystRx retainer usage at 72% of committed for period ending 2026-03-18.
Nina: Need CFO-friendly ask language. Keep it concise.
Eileen: Draft: "Recommend a 12% temporary retainer buffer for Q2 with a 30-day review; pair with a 45-minute enablement to optimize embed usage." Thoughts?
Carlos: Add a short feedback poll in the QBR: 1) "Would you accept temporary throttles during peak traffic to avoid overages?" 2) "Would lower-dim embeddings be acceptable if it reduces cost?"
Samir: Provisioned 30k emergency credits (expires in 7d) and left an account note. Drafted SE checklist: 1) enable prefix caching, 2) reduce top-k/top-p for embed prep, 3) schedule heavy batches off-peak.
Nina: Action items: Carlos - deck + scenario charts (due Thu EOD); Eileen - draft CFO blurb + poll Qs; Samir - confirm credits & finalize SE checklist; Nina - schedule QBR and invite finance lead.
FinOps-Bot: invoice and commit history available at /billing/catalystrx/2026-03.
Carlos: I'll export per-route P95 latency and tokens (CSV) and drop into the deck by Wed.
Eileen: Will post the polished blurb here for a quick edit pass. :thumbsup:
Nina: Using this thread as canonical QBR spend ops for CatalystRx. Ping if anything shifts. :white_check_mark:
